name: NanaZip
title: NanaZip: free WinRAR alternative
caption:
WinRAR costs $29 for one license, and nags you to buy it. NanaZip opens your zip files for free 🗜️

✅ Right-click any file in Windows 11 to extract or zip it
✅ Dark mode everywhere, built for modern Windows
✅ Smart Extraction, plus 7-Zip's formats and more
✅ Built on 7-Zip, 16,000+ stars, 100% free

💻 Windows
ℹ️ NanaZip is free and open source. There's an optional paid Sponsor Edition if you want to support the developer. WinRAR's trial keeps working after 40 days, it just keeps asking you to buy. (7-Zip is free too, but NanaZip adds the Windows 11 look and right-click menu)

Comment "ZIP" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
